bounding.note: The batch is bounded by the frozen allocation: 128 proposals, at most four executions each, at most eight configurations, and no solver selection anywhere on the path. The bulk of the proposals (96 of 128) are 32-element shapes; the two 512-element configurations carry the remaining 32. The interpreter replay budget is raised in this driver only (`build_tensor_exact_loop_case.TIMEOUT_S`), not in the library.

compilations.note: `run_triton_tests.run_case` gives every case its own fresh Triton cache and records it empty at start, so no compilation in this batch reuses another case's cache entry; the compilation count equals the number of executed cases.

budget_bound.admissions: Every proposal is admitted by the exact certificate over the frozen domain, or refused with its reason. Admission cost is the pure-Python exact bound check, not an SMT selection.
budget_bound.executions: At most four compiled-mode device executions per admitted program, the four rules of `test.lib.tensor_input_proposals`.
budget_bound.time: No solver selection is used, so the six-minute 512-lane exact solve the counted builder needs is not on this path. The 512-element configurations (U3, U4) carry 32 of the 128 proposals; the other 96 proposals are 32-element shapes. Device runs are sharded over the visible GPUs, each case with a fresh Triton cache.

frozen_manifest.frozen_rule: This file is written before any proposal is generated. The batch steps refuse to run unless the file on disk digests to the value recorded here, and the file is never rewritten while the batch runs.

half_allocation.note: Four configuration slots are established behavior strata and four are underexplored legal combinations of the same generator. Every proposal count is predeclared per configuration; a rejected proposal is kept and reported rather than replaced.

held_fixed.note: The batch varies the logical program (family, shape, trip count, arithmetic mode) and holds the launch setting at the recorded Track A value, so a difference between configurations is a difference of generated program rather than of launch configuration.

frozen_manifest.seed_freshness: Proposal seeds are 100000 or greater and are disjoint from every seed in the recorded Track A evidence (seeds 0-9). Each proposal is a new seed.
